      "evidence": "Implements an optional index under src/index/txoscriptindex.cpp and related index headers.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Adds a major new index type with clear external demand, addressing a request spanning at least five previous pull requests since 2013 to query history without wallet imports. The index demonstrates efficient resource use at ~52 GB disk usage and works with pruning."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Adds the getscripthistory RPC in src/rpc/blockchain.cpp (+517 lines) and refactors JSON formatting across src/rpc/rawtransaction*.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.60,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Introduces getscripthistory to fill a long-standing interface gap that forced external consumers like Electrum servers to run third-party indexers. Reviewers in this area also need to evaluate query safety budgets and rawtransaction library boundaries."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches test runner and fuzz RPC only to register the new functional test and RPC target.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "The functional and fuzz test additions pin the behavior of the new index and RPC rather than changing core test framework machinery."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Changes to src/init.cpp (+11 lines) only wire up startup initialization for the new index.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Mechanical initialization of an area's subsystem in init.cpp belongs to that subsystem rather than utils infrastructure."
    }

  }
